title: Frog Fungus Has Hit Hundreds And Declines Continue
hook: The worst amphibian disease toll is still unfolding in living species.
closing: Stopping frog fungus matters because many affected species are still losing ground.
question: Which frogs should recovery protect?

segments.say: Frog fungus has affected 501 amphibian species. Its toll reaches across hundreds of species.
Thirty-nine percent of affected species are still declining. The damage continues beyond the initial outbreak.
Frog fungus has hit 40 Australian species. One country's toll shows how broadly the disease reaches.
